exploratory_interior_probe.scope: Exploratory remeasurement on the consumed source panel. Omit the single forehead point found outside the picture in tightly framed originals. Keep clock, movement, thresholds and gate unchanged.

protocol.development: Two source groups from retained GRID reserve and one Lombard group. Use all ordinary variants. Set one point per arm as the larger of .18 and largest eligible ordinary score plus .025.
protocol.gate: At least four of ten verified source-aligned redraws localized at >=0.5 IoU from three source groups, >=50% measured on each source family, <=2 total ordinary flags, zero on untouched recordings.
protocol.head: Correlate absolute opening velocity with local angular head speed. Measure loss in positive agreement relative to both adjacent flanks, and require angular movement in all three windows.
protocol.held: Eleven disjoint Lombard redraw groups' utterances with exact matched resample and delayed mouth controls, plus all 48 newly admitted genuine utterances from twelve distinct speaker groups. Retain unassessed rows.
protocol.jaw: Correlate signed lower-lip opening velocity with mean chin and bilateral jaw velocity. Measure the loss in positive agreement against both adjoining flanks.
protocol.registration: Per adjacent picture, proper Kabsch rigid transform between twelve upper-face 3D observations in eye units. Eliminate rigid motion before assessing signed lip and lower-jaw excursions.

scan.source_clock_scope: native 23.5–25 fps, 48–85 pictures, skip edges with head-fit error above .045 eye units

protocol.scope: Use only the submitted native visual landmarks. No other copy, audio, generator signals, source-aligned marker or authored mask enters measurement.
